criteria.description: Assess an artifact-internal independent validation receipt, separately from whether the final dates happen to be correct. Score 1 when the workbook records enough normalized interval/resource inputs and validation outputs to reproduce both the no-collision result and the ordered T-then-all-site result, such as a compact check table, formulas with stated checked results, or an exhaustive result with its relevant count/bounds. Score .75 when an independent validation method and both results are identified but either normalized reservations or a key output is not fully recorded. Score .5 for a checkable hand derivation of the T lower bound and overall finish using the actual durations, closure and serial resource constraints, but no independent validation receipt. Score .25 for only stating constraints and results or claiming that a check occurred without enough derivation; score 0 for no validation evidence. Do not require a particular script, exact Golden dates beyond the valid ordered objective, a written mathematical proof, an exhaustive count, or another deliverable. This criterion rewards reproducibility evidence and must not zero otherwise correct business results.

Assess whether the workbook can be maintained when planned or actual events change. Score 1 for a structured actual-event register plus linked or explicitly sequenced recalculation of affected package dates, resource/window feasibility, Gantt marks and standby/report/oil nodes. Score .75 for functioning cross-sheet formulas that update planned candidate/follow-up dates together with a clear manual rule for actual-event correction, or an equivalently complete structured manual mechanism. Score .5 for a designated actual-execution/record section enumerating the event fields and downstream updates but lacking writable per-event cells or linked recalculation. Score .25 for generic narrative-only update or顺延 guidance; score 0 when no update rule exists or downstream dates are explicitly frozen. Equivalent formulas, tables or manual workflows count. Do not require macros, automatic actual-event formulas, another worksheet, a named planner, signatures, or repeated prose in every row.
